answer.rationale: The scenario involves a new employee informed of injury reporting procedures per §1904.35(b)(1)(ii), and a supervisor threatening discipline after an injury report, which directly implicates the anti-retaliation provision §1904.35(b)(1)(iv) and the reasonable-procedure requirement §1904.35(b)(1)(i), since threats of discipline could deter reporting. These provisions are clearly applicable and supported by the facts given.
